observation.precondition: real Zones panel

actions.actualText: Derived: crossings use the object's center after a fixed step, not whole-collider overlap. The first stable completed step after start or reset establishes a baseline. This is fixed-step sampling, not a continuous sweep; a fast passage whose sampled endpoints are both outside produces no crossing event. Wireframes show the nominal volume; actual entry uses a contracted boundary and exit uses an expanded boundary to avoid chatter. Disabling only stops occupancy detection; an explicitly authored zone-center anchor remains available. Zones neither collide nor change acoustic or rigid-body roles. Sound remains attached to the object unless the author explicitly selects the zone-center anchor.
